purpose: One bounded four-state model acquisition plus an after-baseline drift control under the reinforced original fixture
operator_prerequisite: Operator confirmed tape access can avoid touching sensor mounting, pulling cable or lifting board
after_baseline_role: drift control; never select the baseline yielding the smallest closure
trial_zero: original C blade at start of this batch, newly marked p0; historical A/B/C identity is retained separately
positive_direction: clockwise in one operator-selected viewing face, recorded before acquisition
blade_numbering: On 9-blade rotor, starting p0 as blade1 count clockwise: blade4=p120, blade7=p240
trial_mass_scope: same intact tape piece at all three positions; no calibrated absolute mass supplied
attachment_surface: same blade surface for all trial placements, as original C tape
wait_scope: uniform delay only, not proof of thermal or RPM steady state
amplitude_source: CPU references; original prepared-input arithmetic already independently verified on FPGA, this batch produces no new FPGA arithmetic
model_policy: PC review uses first baseline and three trial states, retains all windows, reports after-baseline change and sensitivity. Existing solver gates are not bypassed. Missing absolute mass is retained, not replaced by fictitious grams.
